svg.aria-label: Win’s VPN Inc. Certificate of Recognition and written acknowledgment of charitable contribution
svg.title: Win’s VPN Inc. — Certificate of Recognition and Contemporaneous Written Acknowledgment
svg.text: Win’s VPN Inc. gratefully acknowledges the charitable contribution of
Supporting censorship-resistant network access, cybersecurity, and access to uncensored news and education.
Non-cash gifts are described, not valued: the IRS requires the donor, not the organization, to determine value.
GOODS OR SERVICES PROVIDED IN RETURN FOR THIS CONTRIBUTION
AUTHORIZED SIGNATURE FOR WIN’S VPN INC.
Win’s VPN Inc. is exempt from federal income tax under Internal Revenue Code Section 501(c)(3), effective June 11, 2026, and is classified as a public charity under Section 509(a)(2).
Contributions are deductible under IRC Section 170 to the extent allowed by law. Deductibility depends on your own tax situation. Win’s VPN Inc. does not provide tax advice.
Tax-exempt status is a determination about the organization. It is not an IRS review, approval, or endorsement of the Win’s VPN service, its security, or its performance.
Retain this acknowledgment with your tax records. Do not attach it to your federal income tax return. A written acknowledgment is required for any single contribution of $250 or more.

Verify our exempt status independently at apps.irs.gov/app/eos using EIN {{EIN}}. This acknowledgment follows IRS Publication 1771, Charitable Contributions — Substantiation and Disclosure Requirements.
